items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: except for Brunus and Santo and the others, who played well, beautiful.

ctx.x: And always of the instruments that I think the new audience playing, I think the clarinetist and of course trumpet, trombone, except for good tailgate and good playing, well, of course, Charlie Miller and Julian Lane played well and there were others. But there never was a tromboneist example like Jack or, of course, there weren't many of those ever. But today, of course, the style that he created is used by everybody to some extent. But just somehow, to me, except for Brunus and Santo and the others, who played…
And, if you had to name a single famous New Orleans saxophone player, you could name one, I'd say. Eddie Miller, of course.
